title: Loyalty, Cohesion, Factionalism & Internal Politics
objective: Deliver a bounded read-only, profile/context-driven projection for loyalty, cohesion, factionalism and internal-politics state over explicit visible canonical-owner observations while keeping MIB-09 relationship/reputation truth authoritative, keeping ODL-02 pressure advisory-only, and preventing automatic faction creation, relationship mutation, political outcomes, command authority or permission escalation.

governed_contract.observation_rule: ODL-03 accepts only explicit owner-referenced qualitative observations carrying subject, dimension, profile, context, provenance and visibility references. It does not infer loyalty, cohesion, factionalism or political state from ODL-02 pressure bands, member counts, title/rank, hierarchy, faction labels, money, location, elapsed time or other unstated owner state.
governed_contract.resolution_rule: After visibility filtering, a dimension resolves only when visible compatible observed evidence agrees on one governed qualitative band under one profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown evidence remains unknown; incompatible-only evidence remains incompatible; divergent bands, profiles, contexts or mixed observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. ODL-03 never auto-resolves canonical-owner contradictions.
governed_contract.pressure_context_rule: Visible ODL-02 capacity/coordination/load evidence may be attached only as separately labeled advisory context. It never advances or changes an ODL-03 dimension state and never automatically lowers loyalty/cohesion, raises factionalism, or creates political outcomes.
governed_contract.faction_rule: Faction labels, alignments and references are descriptive owner-backed evidence only. ODL-03 does not create factions, add/remove members, derive membership, or manufacture faction existence from labels or pressure.
governed_contract.relationship_rule: MIB-09 relationship/reputation edges, Loyalty-style dimensions, event application, history and reputation projections remain canonical. ODL-03 reads explicit visible owner observations but never mutates relationship/reputation state or publishes hidden edges.
governed_contract.political_outcome_rule: No coup, split, mutiny, crisis, fragmentation, leadership replacement, succession, command restriction or other political outcome is adjudicated in ODL-03. Such outcomes remain for their later canonical owners/tranches.
governed_contract.permission_rule: Organizational title, rank, membership, hierarchy, faction label, loyalty/cohesion/factionalism band or political-pressure label never grants system permission, action authority or autonomous command authority.
governed_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized motives, relationships, reputation edges, faction references, loyalty/cohesion observations, political evidence, profile/context references and ODL-02 advisory context are filtered before dimension state, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts or AI context. Hidden cardinality is not disclosed.
governed_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-03 persistence, duplicate relationship/reputation/faction/politics ledger or migration 0022.
governed_contract.ui: One accessible read-only panel with nonvisual dimension, owner/provenance, profile/context, advisory-pressure, unknown/conflict/incompatible and authority-boundary explanations.
governed_contract.validation: Exactly one ODL-03 current-family profile; genuine RED before production; final exact-head self-hosted Linux and Windows plus deterministic comparator; zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01/02 remain completed_verified and are not reopened.
Canonical MIB-09 Relationship/Reputation plus Organization/Faction, Character, WCI, DPL, Project/time/context and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.

No relationship/reputation mutation, faction creation or membership mutation, loyalty/cohesion owner mutation, automatic pressure-to-disloyalty/factionalism conversion, coup/crisis/split outcome, command authority, system permission, campaign-time advancement, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is introduced.
ODL-04+, SCL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

retry_basis.evidence: Owner Continue requested ODL-03 execution immediately after ODL-02 closeout. Governed start resolves one bounded read-only four-dimension projection contract from explicit visible owner observations with ODL-02 pressure separated as advisory-only context.
changed_since_previous: ODL-02 is completed_verified and its authority retired.
ODL-03 moved from selection-only to one explicit bounded governed contract without product mutation.
